country.comment: Study examines the Metropolitan Area of Buenos Aires (AMBA), comprising the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires and surrounding municipalities in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina.
country.where_found: PDF p. 1, Title; PDF p. 2, Resumen/Abstract; PDF p. 3, Introducción

effect_estimate.comment: No inferential statistical model is estimated. Note minor internal discrepancy in the paper between text percentages on p. 16 (61.5%, 24%, 9.5%, 3%, 2% for systems; 70%, 11%, 8%, 8%, 3% for population) and chart labels in Fig. 1 (66%, 19%, 10%, 3%, 2%) and Fig. 2 (71%, 10%, 8%, 8%, 3%); both are reported here for completeness.
effect_estimate.value: Qualitative — no numeric effect estimate reported. Descriptive mapping identified at least 365 decentralized ('desvinculados') water and sanitation systems serving 498,483 inhabitants across 21 AMBA municipalities within AySA's concession area (classified in text as 61.5% neighborhood organizations [66% in Fig. 1] serving 70% of users [71% in Fig. 2], 24% private operation [19% in Fig. 1] serving 11% [10% in Fig. 2], 9.5% without operator [10% in Fig. 1] serving 8%, 3% cooperatives serving 8%, and 2% municipal operation serving 3%). Among 264 systems audited by ERAS (2022), 46% (122) lacked chlorination, 30% (80) had nitrate contamination, and 20% (48) had bacteriological contamination; however, fragmented agency definitions and AySA expansion rules prioritizing proximity to the served network and water supply feasibility rather than ERAS water-quality risk exclude peripheral systems from formal integration.
effect_estimate.where_found: PDF pp. 13-14, Resultados; PDF pp. 15-20, Discusión, Tabla 3, and Figuras 1-2; PDF pp. 20-21, Conclusiones

mechanism_certainty.comment: Capped at 2 by qualitative study design (CASP). Rated 2 because the study directly observes and documents the legal, regulatory, and administrative mechanisms—statutory 'precarious' status and service-area demarcation under Law 26.221 Art. 6, divergent definitions and uncoordinated registries across AySA/ERAS/APLA/municipalities, operatorless state-built housing networks, inspection barriers in gated communities, and AySA's expansion prioritization rules excluding ERAS water-quality contamination alerts.
mechanism_certainty.where_found: PDF pp. 12-14, Resultados; PDF pp. 18-20, Discusión

mechanism_flags.comment: Examines statutory demarcation of regulated, served, and expansion areas under Law 26.221 Art. 6 and AySA's proximity/feasibility incorporation rules (ELIGIBILITY: service_area, planning), overlapping national/provincial/municipal jurisdictions and conflicting definitions of unlinked systems (DISCRETION_ACCOMMODATION: institutional_fragmentation, political_coordination), community/neighborhood/cooperative self-management (participation), and ERAS water-quality auditing/inspection limitations (ENFORCEMENT).
mechanism_flags.value: ELIGIBILITY, DISCRETION_ACCOMMODATION, ENFORCEMENT, planning, service_area, participation, institutional_fragmentation, political_coordination
mechanism_flags.where_found: PDF pp. 11-14, Resultados; PDF pp. 14-20, Discusión

outcome_flags.comment: Analyzes municipal network water and sewerage coverage (Table 1), water and sanitation access for 498,483 residents via 365 unlinked systems (Table 3), drinking water quality and raw sewage discharge failures (46% unchlorinated, 30% nitrates, 20% bacteriological contamination in ERAS audits, pp. 18-19), and barriers to formal incorporation into AySA's served network (pp. 12-13, 17, 20).

sample_size.comment: Primary qualitative fieldwork conducted in 2022 included 15 in-depth interviews with key informants (ERAS, APLA, SSRH, AySA, municipal actors, and residents) and technical site visits; field mapping combined with ERAS (2022) and UNSADA (2022) records identified a minimum universe of 365 unlinked systems across 21 of the 26 AySA-concessioned municipalities (data unavailable for 5 municipalities: Avellaneda, Lanús, Lomas de Zamora, San Fernando, and Vicente López).
sample_size.value: 15 in-depth interviews (14 in-person, 1 virtual); 365 mapped 'desvinculados' (unlinked/decentralized water and sanitation services) serving 498,483 inhabitants across 21 municipalities (plus 264 ERAS-audited unlinked services)
sample_size.where_found: PDF p. 6, Metodología; PDF pp. 15-16, Discusión and Tabla 3; PDF p. 19, Discusión; PDF p. 20, Conclusiones

study_design.comment: Authors explicitly describe the design as an exploratory and descriptive qualitative approach combining primary in-depth interviews (n=15), technical site visits, documentary/regulatory analysis (Law 26.221 and ERAS/APLA resolutions), and descriptive tabulation of secondary census (INDEC 2022), regulatory (ERAS 2022), and field mapping records.
study_design.value: Exploratory and descriptive qualitative case study (in-depth key-informant interviews, technical site visits, legal/regulatory document analysis, and descriptive secondary/field mapping)
